integrationMode: One Unreal plugin and one runtime module. Each phase adds only its portable headers and sources; all phases compile inside the same module to avoid cross-module export macros for the engine-neutral C++ types.

phases.name: Core
phases.description: Shared IDs, revisions, math contracts, and runtime profiles.

phases.name: Terrain
phases.description: Density terrain, derived mesh data, revision/dirty queues, and placement snap rules.

phases.name: Construction
phases.description: Excavation preflight, shoring plans, and structural integrity decisions.

phases.name: Environment
phases.description: Water/soil/fire simulation and survival exposure calculations.

phases.name: PersistenceGameplay
phases.description: Versioned density persistence, restore staging, raid/spawn decisions, work scheduling, material rules, plant/animal models, and crafting preflight.
